# schemas

- [Glob schema][sokf:schema-glob] - A glob that governs an index. No glob is allowed to govern an index.
- [Issue schema][sokf:schema-issue] - An issue tracked through its lifecycle.
- [Note schema][sokf:schema-note] - A note.
